news.title: BPI Finds Only Two Major Stablecoins Meet Its Historical Reserve Test
news.body: The Bank Policy Institute examined June 2026 holdings for ten dollar stablecoins covering 97% of the market and found only USDC and PYUSD aligned with GENIUS Act reserve-asset requirements. Those two represented 26% of tokens outstanding, but the industry association’s assessment does not establish current regulatory noncompliance or redemption reliability. The comparison gives banks, payment processors and treasury teams a historical due-diligence input, rather than a substitute for current reserve disclosures.

news.title: Nubank and Mercado Pago Restrict Crypto Transfers After Reported Provider Problems
news.body: Nubank suspended Brazilian crypto deposits and withdrawals after a partner problem, while Mercado Pago blocked some external-wallet transfers following instability involving a risk-monitoring and AML provider. Nubank said customer assets and information remained protected; the report did not establish whether the incidents shared a provider or cause. Customers faced restricted transfers and potentially delayed deposits, highlighting crypto platforms’ dependence on external monitoring services for transaction availability.

news.title: BMO Targets Shorter Card-Service Calls With Employee-Facing AI and Human Review
news.body: BMO announced AI Agent Assist for Canadian credit-card transaction inquiries, combining transaction matching, policy retrieval and case preparation with human review. Against more than 500,000 annual calls averaging 12–14 minutes, the bank targets a 20–30% handling-time reduction and automatic processing of approximately 40% of eligible credit-refund requests. These are targets rather than demonstrated results; the deployment supports employees handling card inquiries, not autonomous consumer purchasing or unrestricted payment initiation.

news.title: Synctera Raises $24.5 Million to Fund Sponsor-Bank Infrastructure and Compliance Tools
news.body: Following its April 2026 acquisition of continuous-control-testing provider Cable, Synctera raised $24.5 million to support its sponsor-bank and fintech infrastructure business. The funding adds resources for program management and compliance tooling, but does not itself demonstrate stronger controls or a recovery in banking-as-a-service demand. Control-testing coverage, remediation evidence and onboarding performance provide sponsor banks with more direct measures of the platform’s capabilities than the financing total.

news.title: PayFacto Plans Konek Integration to Add Account-Based Payments Across Canadian Merchants
news.body: Canadian merchants in PayFacto’s network are the intended recipients of a new account-based checkout option: Interac announced that PayFacto is integrating Konek across its merchant and partner networks alongside card payments. The announcement establishes integration plans, not completed merchant rollout, transaction volumes or demonstrated savings. Live availability, pricing, settlement timing and refund handling remain necessary details for merchants assessing the option.

perspective: Nubank’s transfer restrictions and BMO’s AI plans put service reliability and controls alongside new funding and checkout integrations.

curiosity.text: Barclays installed a cash dispenser in Enfield, London, on June 27, 1967. Instead of inserting a plastic bank card, customers used special paper vouchers that the machine retained—a different access mechanism from today’s ATMs. Source: Smithsonian Magazine, “A Brief History of the ATM” — https://www.smithsonianmag.com/history/brief-history-atm-180953547/
